about.title: Chinese Laoshi
about.intro: Chinese Laoshi (中国老师) is a Mandarin learning app for custom flashcards, hanzi handwriting practice, and translation drills — in the browser on phone, tablet, or desktop.
about.handwritingFeature: Handwriting practice — write Chinese characters with touch or mouse and get stroke feedback.
about.translationFeature: Translation drills — review meanings and strengthen recall with flashcard study modes.
about.customGroupsFeature: Custom word groups — build your own card decks with characters, pinyin, and translations.
about.openSourceBody: The project is open source on GitHub.
